title: #lumen-eng: Sprint 14 kickoff — auth v2 and design token sprint

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: Sprint 14 goals: (1) Auth v2 endpoint (LMNE-22) — this is the big one, Atlas is blocked on us. (2) Design token migration (LMNE-21) — large refactor but needed for dark mode. (3) Clear the bug backlog: dark mode flicker (LMNE-18), data grid perf (LMNE-20), React upgrade (LMNE-19).

messages.author: kai-zhang
messages.text: Happy to drive design token migration. It's going to be a 300+ file change but the Figma sync tooling should make it systematic. I'll pair with dev on the skeleton loaders once the tokens land.

messages.author: dev-okonkwo
messages.text: On the dark mode flicker and data grid — both are isolated fixes, should be done early sprint. Then I'll start skeleton loaders.

title: #lumen-eng: Auth v2 scopes design — PM review needed

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: Auth v2 scopes design: I'm proposing we include `tenantId` (string) and `scopes` (string array, e.g. ['billing:read', 'billing:write']) in the v2 token payload. This is what Atlas needs for premium tier gating. Sharing Notion doc for PM review.

messages.author: kai-zhang
messages.text: The `scopes` field naming aligns with OAuth 2.0 convention — good call. What's the PM timeline for sign-off?

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: Sent the doc to Marcus (PM) this morning. He's traveling Thursday/Friday so I don't expect sign-off until next week. I'll start implementation on the undisputed parts (token structure, endpoint scaffolding) in the meantime.

title: #lumen-eng: Dark mode flicker — context on root cause

messages.author: kai-zhang
messages.text: Root cause on LMNE-18 (dark mode flicker): ThemeContext is initialized asynchronously after first render. Browser paints with system default (light), then switches — hence the flash. Fix: synchronous initialization using a localStorage read before React hydrates. PR #32 up.

messages.author: dev-okonkwo
messages.text: Nice find. The localStorage approach is the standard SSR hydration fix. Should work across all browsers. Reviewing now.
